title: [Test Gap][reload config test on Cisco 8000][All Topos]Enable test_reload_configuration_checks on Cisco 8000
author: cyw233
body:
### Test Gap Description

Currently, the `platform_tests/test_reload_config.py::test_reload_configuration_checks` test case is skipped on Cisco 8000 for most releases, because Cisco platform has flaky timing issue. We should enhance the `reboot()` function ([link](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/platform_tests/test_reload_config.py#L148)) in the test to support it on Cisco 8000.
